component.name: Story Start
component.description: Turns the opening lines you type into the story artifact.
component.script:
import perceivo
from perceivo.primitives import Artifact, ArtifactType, StartInput, StartOutput


@perceivo.start
async def story_start(input: StartInput) -> StartOutput:
    """Make the opening lines the story artifact, and count its words."""
    opening = input.request_data.get("opening", "").strip()
    if not opening:
        raise ValueError("'opening' is required.")

    return StartOutput(
        # The artifact carries the story to the next component.
        artifact=Artifact(type=ArtifactType.TEXT, data=opening),
        # Response data carries facts about it.
        response_data={"words_in_opening": len(opening.split())},
    )
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: START
name: Story Start
description: Turns the opening lines you type into the story artifact.
tags:
  - beginner
  - start
external_in_port:
  port_name: external_in
  port_type: external_in
  artifact_type_input: json
  artifact_type_output: text
  request_data:
    opening:
      type: string
      description: The first lines of a story.
output_ports:
  - port_name: output
    port_type: out
    artifact_type_input: json
    # The artifact is the work itself: the story, as text.
    artifact_type_output: text
    # Response data is small, structured facts about the work.
    response_data:
      words_in_opening:
        type: integer
        description: How many words the opening has.
input_parameters: []
input_prompt: Type the first lines of a story.
required_secrets: []

opening.description: The first lines of a story.

words_in_opening.description: How many words the opening has.
